annotations.text: Round 3 (2026-11-16), Prathik's answers: all five together up to 12 months; a button focuses one measure at any range; the range is the whole dashboard's. Last 12 months and This year show 'All five' (one row each) or any one measure; Last 2 years and Last 3 years show one measure at a time and 'All five' goes dim. MzB proposes which Overview parts follow the range.

Round 2 (2026-11-16): a range of several years, Nov 2023 to Oct 2026. The last twelve months are the Expenses canvas's; the earlier two years are made up. Records start late for some measures (cash expenses Jan 2025, card bills Aug 2025, EMIs Aug 2026), so a long range has honest blanks at the start.

Overview · Month by month (round 1, 2026-11-16). Income, investments, EMIs, credit card bills and cash expenses as five separate widgets, five ways. Every figure is the Expenses canvas's made-up year (Nov 2025 to Oct 2026), so the widget agrees with /expenses. Hover any month for its detail; C and E are interactive.
